title: FLOYD SUPERCACHE Usage Guide Documentation
purpose: Provide comprehensive instructions on effective SUPERCACHE usage across all Floyd documentation locations

key_points.best_practice: Before work: search; During: store reasoning; After: extract patterns

quick_reference: cache_store - Save any data with optional TTL
cache_retrieve - Get stored data by key
cache_search - Find cached content by query
cache_store_reasoning - Capture decision logic (context, reasoning, conclusion)
cache_stats - Check cache health and size
cache_prune - Remove old entries by age
